title: Automotive Heat Exchanger Market | Industry Report, 2034
content: # Automotive Heat Exchanger Market Size, Share & Industry Analysis, By Type (Liquid-to-Air and Air-to-air), By Propulsion (ICE and Electric), By Vehicle Type (Passenger Cars and Commercial Vehicles), and Regional Forecast, 2026-2034. ## Automotive Heat Exchanger Market Size, Trends & Key Companies. The global automotive heat exchanger market size was valued at USD 11.67 billion in 2025 and is projected to grow from USD 12.06 billion in 2026 to USD 16.25 billion by 2034, exhibiting a CAGR of 3.80% during the forecast period. Asia Pacific dominated the global market with a market share of 56.67% in 2025. * The global automotive heat exchanger market reached USD 11.67 billion in 2025. * It is projected to reach USD 16.25 billion by 2034, growing at a CAGR of 3.80%. * Asia Pacific dominated the market with a 56.67% share in 2025. * Liquid-to-air heat exchangers led the market in 2024. | Market Size in 2025 | USD 11.67 Billion |.
